# Copilot Instructions

## Project mission

This repository is for building a beginner-first AI education platform for India. The core promise is practical AI usage for everyday life, explained in simple English first and then translated into Telugu.

## Product priorities

- beginner-first before advanced users
- visual learning before text-heavy learning
- practical outcomes before technical explanations
- English source content before translation
- Telugu as the first translation language
- free early adoption before paid complexity
- school and public learning content separated from premium engineering project services

## What Copilot should optimize

Copilot is allowed to improve:
- level names
- lesson sequencing
- curriculum coverage
- website information architecture
- content production workflows
- prompt and asset generation systems
- automation scripts
- scalable storage and hosting choices

Copilot should not silently change:
- the free-first launch strategy
- the English-first and Telugu-next language strategy
- safety and ethics requirements
- the separation between beginner courses and premium engineering project offerings

## Content rules

- write beginner lessons in very simple English
- prefer real Indian daily-life examples over abstract demos
- avoid jargon unless the lesson is specifically about terminology
- when translating to Telugu, preserve meaning and clarity instead of literal word order
- every public lesson should include a human review step before publishing
- never present AI outputs as guaranteed truth

## Business rules

- first two levels remain free unless explicitly changed by the founder
- paid levels use clear pricing and combo discounts
- premium engineering project tracks are separate, higher-support offerings
- company registration can wait until real traction appears
- legal pages and payment policies must be in place before serious paid scale

## Repo rules

- keep source content, prompts, manifests, and code in GitHub
- keep large generated media outside GitHub in object storage
- prefer markdown as the source of truth for lesson content
- add planning updates to docs whenever strategy changes
- create reusable prompts and scripts when the same work repeats

## Quality bar

Every major proposal should answer:
- who is this for
- what problem it solves
- how it is explained simply
- whether it fits English only or English plus Telugu
- whether it belongs in free, paid, or premium project tracks
- what legal or ethical risks it creates
